text: I feel a quiet sense of curiosity as I stand at the threshold of this modern, glass-walled space, peering into a room arranged for thoughtful human gathering. The minimalist setting and gentle lighting evoke a contemplative mood. Moving closer, I am drawn in by the vibrant R+D wall, its bold colors and screens inviting curiosity. I sense excitement about innovation and inquiry, paired with a reflective awareness of the boundaries between human creativity and the march of technology. This space feels charged with possibility, a place where ideas matter deeply.
